abstract: A karyotypically normal, chromosomally female (X/X) in vitro line of mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells was established from a malignant mouse teratocarcinoma of the 129/Sv Sl C P inbred strain. The tumor of origin was experimentally induced by ectopic transplantation of a 6-day embryo. The normal number of chromosomes was observed in 92% of metaphases of the cultured cells. This high frequency of euploidy, as well as karyotypic normalcy, were maintained during numerous passages in culture without a feeder-cell layer and after freezing and thawing of the cells. The line has been designated METT-1 (Mouse Euploid Totipotent Teratocarcinoma), signifying that it is the first such in vitro line that has proved (in tests by T. Stewart and B. Mintz, manuscript in preparation) to be developmentally totipotent, i.e., capable of both somatic and germinal differentiation when injected into blastocysts, even after freezing and thawing and prolonged culture. This unique ensemble of properties renders the cell line suitable for selection of specific mutant genes and for gene-transfer experiments in culture, for the purpose of producing from the mutant cells new strains of mice with predetermined genetic changes.
abstract_ja: 核型が正常で雌（X/X）の染色体構成をもつマウス奇形癌幹細胞のin vitro株を樹立した。この腫瘍は129/Sv Sl C P近交系の悪性マウス奇形癌で、6日齢胚の異所移植によって実験的に誘発されたものである。培養細胞の中期細胞の92%で正常染色体数が観察された。この高い倍数性頻度と核型の正常性は、フィーダー細胞層のない培養下での多数継代後、ならびに凍結融解後も維持された。この株はMETT-1（Mouse Euploid Totipotent Teratocarcinoma）と命名された。これは、胚盤胞へ注入した際に体細胞および生殖細胞への分化能（発生全能性）を示すことが証明された、最初のin vitro株である（T. StewartおよびB. Mintzによる試験、原稿準備中）。凍結融解後および長期培養後においても発生全能性を保持していた。この特性の組み合わせにより、本細胞株は培養下での特定変異遺伝子の選択や遺伝子導入実験に適しており、所定の遺伝的変化をもつ新たなマウス系統の作出に利用できる。
